A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was the [[Parent/Legends#Grandparent|grandfather]] of the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Lanoree Brock|Lanoree]] and [[Dalien Brock]]. While his grandson, Dalien, was a child, this individual passed a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] down to him. Dalien would continue to use the pistol throughout his life, and at one point used it to save his sister and himself from a [[silik lizard]].<ref name="Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lanoree Brock's grandfather was first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]]. He was first mentioned as the former owner of Dalien Brock's blaster pistol.<ref name="Void" />
